title: Block Values and Scopes
goal: Return an integer from a block expression without leaking local variables.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 1 Morning: Control Flow Basics

hints: Check which block owns `factor`. It disappears at the closing brace.
The block must produce an `i32` into `scaled`.
explanation: The last expression in a block becomes its value when written without a semicolon. `base * 3` evaluates to `15` and assigns it to `scaled`. `factor` lives only inside the block scope, so accessing it outside causes error `E0425`. Adding a semicolon to `scaled + 1;` makes the function return `()` instead of `i32`, causing error `E0308`.
